events.title: Release Date Announcement!
events.summary: Bottled By Bears is coming November 11, 2026! We're happy to finally announce the release date of our first game! We'd be thrilled if you decide to get it at release and share your experience with us If you're interested, we're running a playtest throughout September with extended content (all main features) to get player feedback and keep improving the game. events.title: The announcement trailer is out!
events.summary: The first trailer for Bottled By Bears is now live 🎥 It was a fun and challenging experience to edit a video for the first time! We are happy with the results and we will keep improving for the upcoming ones with more new features footage 🫡 This is also the first post in here, and we'll start using this space a lot more from now on. Expect dev updates, milestones reached, and more behind the scenes bits as we get closer to release. Thank you for your support!
